title: Effort to account for Soviet nukes after the collapse

tellings.quote: And the US government at that time launched a heroic really heroic effort with the Russians to try to account for every nuclear weapon.

plain: After the Soviet Union fell apart in 1991, the US government worked with the Russians in Moscow to track down every one of the old Soviet nuclear weapons, says Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former chief at the CIA, America's foreign spy agency. He tells it as someone who was there, and calls it "a heroic really heroic effort".
